item.title: How to Pay Federal Payroll Taxes with EFTPS (2026)
item.description: EFTPS is how employers pay federal payroll taxes: withheld income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA. This guide covers enrollment, monthly vs. semiweekly deposit schedules, the 8 p.m. ET deadline, the $100,000 next-day rule, same-day wires, and late-deposit penalties — with worked examples.
